title: Inconsistent flash attention usage between rank 0 and other ranks
body:
Hi, I noticed that there's an inconsistency in the model initialization between rank 0 and other ranks in the `FSDPWorker._build_model_optimizer()` method.
```python
if self.rank == 0:
            model = auto_class.from_pretrained(
                model_config.model_path,
                config=self.model_config,
                torch_dtype=torch_dtype,
                attn_implementation="flash_attention_2",
                device_map="cpu",
                low_cpu_mem_usage=True,
                trust_remote_code=model_config.trust_remote_code,
            )
  else:
            with no_init_weights(), init_empty_weights():
                model = auto_class.from_config(
                    self.model_config,
                    torch_dtype=torch_dtype,
                    trust_remote_code=model_config.trust_remote_code,
                )
```
Questions:
1. Is this intentional? 
2. Could this cause any issues since different ranks might be using different attention implementations?
3. If this is a bug, should we add `attn_implementation="flash_attention_2"` to the non-rank-0 initialization as well?

Would appreciate any clarification on this. Thanks!
author: wdp-007

comments.body: Yeah it is not intended, thanks for pointing it out
